days.title: Ancient Forests and Peat Bogs
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Bosque de Munieḷḷos
stops.detail: In the park there is one of the most extensive oak forests in Europe, called the Munieḷḷos forest, which is located in the valley of the same name.

stops.name: Turberas de Reconco
stops.detail: We can also find in certain areas the small yellow water lily found in the Reconco peat bogs, the only place on the peninsula where it grows, or the Muniellos buttercup, an endemic species that grows in stony ground.

stops.name: Valle de Degaña
stops.detail: The natural park also has a large number of valleys, among which the Degaña Valley stands out.

stops.name: Valle De Hermo
stops.detail: The most important beech forest found within the park is the one in Valle De Hermo, covering an area of 10 km.
